services.title: Services
services.lead: Everything the Studio depends on. The state refreshes on its own.
services.loadFailed: Could not load the service state.
services.offLead: These services are not configured in the server environment. The Studio works without them, but some features are unavailable.
services.reasonCode: Reason code for the server log

summary.downBody: {{names}}. The cards below say what is affected.
summary.degradedBody: {{names}}. The Studio works, but slower than usual.

role.database: Accounts, projects and the job queue.
role.storage: Project files, build results and attachments.
role.languagetool: Spelling and grammar checks in the editor.
role.onlyoffice: Editing Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents.
role.runners: Machines that run builds and checks.
role.smtp: Invitations, email confirmation and password reset.

impact.database: People cannot sign in or open projects.
impact.storage: Project files and build results do not open.
impact.languagetool: Spell checking in the editor is unavailable.
impact.onlyoffice: Office documents cannot be opened for editing.
impact.runners: Builds and checks wait in the queue.
impact.smtp: Invitation and password reset emails are not sent.

off.database: The Studio does not work without a database.
off.storage: Project files and builds have nowhere to be stored.
off.languagetool: Spell checking in the editor is off.
off.onlyoffice: Office documents cannot be edited in the Studio.
off.runners: There are no runners, so nothing gets built.
off.smtp: No emails are sent; invitations are shared as links.
